name: Improved Filter Options
author: Brandon
description:
A clipboard for filter settings, built into the filter menus. COPY the settings (materials, allow/block) shown by the filter menu that is open - the row being edited, or the setting new filters take - and PASTE the clipboard into any other filter menu: onto a Mk.1, Mk.2 or Mk.3 row, or into new filters. It works across kinds: copy a Mk.2, paste onto a Mk.3, and back. The clipboard is kept by material name, so it survives reloads and moving to another PC.

HOW
Whenever a filter menu is up (a filter in hand, or a placed row opened in its editor), a Clipboard strip appears in the same band above the hotbar: COPY / PASTE work on what that menu shows. PICK FROM MAP and PASTE ONTO MAP arm a click on any placed filter instead, for a row that isn't open in a menu - while you pick, the building in hand is put down and every filter row on screen shows the game's kind of label (what it filters, allow/block), and you can click a label instead of the filter; the building is handed back after. Esc or right-click cancels.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the filter clipboard panel off without unsubscribing.

copyAlsoSetsNew.descriptionKey: When ON, copying from a placed row also makes the next Mk.2 / Mk.3 filters you place take those settings (the same setting the filter panel edits). When OFF, PASTE into the new-filter menu does that.
